text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Chibuluma mine of Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines is sold to the Metorex Consortium comprising two South African mining firms and another from Canada.
- The Mineworkers Union of Zambia calls on investors buying Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines assets to consider investing in infrastructure such as housing.
- A strike by Zambia Railways workers ends as the firm immediately raises passenger fares by 30 percent.
- Twenty three opposition leaders and supporters plead not guilty to charges of rioting.
- The civil servants union warns that it will call a nation-wide strike if workers salaries are not reviewed by the end of August.
